title: 安布尔沃思三家庭抵达行程
instruction:
您是搬迁礼宾员，周一和周二为三个周日抵达的人提供服务。物业、学校、银行和交通部门确认的一切都在`Ambleworth_arrival_bundle.docx`；请把它变成鲁斯兰博蒙特可以运行的时间表，而无需打电话给我们。我需要所有 14 次观看，包括学校预约和银行签字，以及过境时间表、财产通道、旅行时间和鲁斯兰的合同中断。任何需要葡萄牙语的事情他都必须留在巴西家庭。包括预期里程、港口、停车位和总路线成本，以便 Linnea Lockhart 可以在发布之前检查计划。给我 `Ambleworth_viewing_itinerary.xlsx`，其中包含名为 `Client Check`、`Driver Run Sheet` 和 `Route & Cost Notes` 的工作表。 Mark 将约会添加为`Scheduled`，显示足够的位置、联系人、乘客和访问详细信息，以便 Ruslan 执行每个站点，并保持客户和司机视图之间的每次相同。将您所依赖的任何假设或来源例外情况放入注释表中。使用该文件名将完成的文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：
- `references/Ambleworth_arrival_bundle.docx` — 已确认的混合格式案例包，包含家庭资料、预约确认、房产查看记录、路线信息、港口时间表、司机条款、成本假设和客户说明。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `Ambleworth_viewing_itinerary.xlsx` — 为期两天的客户检查行程、可执行的司机运行表和路线成本说明包。 （工作簿必须包含名为“客户检查”、“司机运行表”以及“路线和成本说明”的表格。；必须包括所有 14 处房产查看、两次学校预约和 1 次银行签名，并标记为“已安排”。；客户检查和司机运行表时间必须一致。；该计划必须遵守所提供的可用性、旅行、港口、通知、语言支持和司机休息限制。；必须显示预期里程、港口、停车和总路线成本。；该文件必须写入工作目录的顶层使用所需的确切文件名。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

spec.professional_context: Anouk Ferreiro is coordinating three assignee-family arrivals for Ambleworth Relocation. The completed workbook will be used by driver-guide Ruslan Beaumont and checked by the client contacts at Saltmarsh Agricultural and Coppergate Freight.
difficulty_sources: Reconciling fixed appointments, property availability, travel times, harbour departures, notice requirements, language support, and contractual breaks
Applying per-record Notes exceptions that supersede the corresponding main fields
Selecting a feasible two-day sequence when individually reasonable choices conflict later in the route
Keeping the client itinerary, driver run sheet, and projected cost summary internally consistent

source_construction.general: Create one polished DOCX case bundle whose text and tables are fully extractable. It must be complete and mutually consistent, with all dates, times, addresses, contacts, family assignments, route inputs and prices needed to produce a feasible Monday–Tuesday itinerary offline. Do not include a purpose-built precedence guide or scheduling procedure.
source_construction.family_facts: Make Camila Zuniga the Brazilian assignee whose family requires Portuguese support. Assign the other two families consistently to the supplied client organisations. Give each family a passenger count and any child information needed for harbour pricing. One child must be exactly the published adult-fare threshold age.
source_construction.property_records: Include fourteen confirmed property-viewing records labeled V01 through V14. Each must provide family assignment, property/building name, complete synthetic address, zone, contact detail, nominal availability, nominal duration, access or meeting instructions, and a free-text Notes field. The records collectively must include two appointment-only buildings with fixed ninety-minute viewing windows and one building requiring at least twenty-four hours' notice.
source_construction.fixed_appointments: Include two fixed school appointments labeled S01 and S02 and one fixed bank signing labeled B01. Both schools must explicitly accept only the Brazilian family and require the driver-guide's Portuguese support. Each appointment must state its date, start, duration, location, contact, attendees and arrival instruction.
source_construction.travel_inputs: Provide a complete zone-to-zone travel-time and distance table sufficient for every feasible consecutive stop, including terminal access time. State whether travel times are elapsed driving minutes and ensure the matrix supports one known feasible route.
source_construction.harbour_inputs: Provide direction-specific terminal details and a timetable under which departures operate every thirty minutes before 15:00 and hourly from 15:00 onward. Include loading/check-in time, crossing duration and vehicle/passenger fare terms. Label the four crossing legs in the intended feasible route C01 through C04 in the confirmation material without revealing the route order as an answer.
source_construction.driver_terms: State a contractual uninterrupted break duration and an allowed midday interval for each working day. State duty-start and duty-finish limits and make the intended route comply.
source_construction.cost_inputs: Supply a per-kilometre reimbursement rate, parking charges or validations for relevant stops, and harbour fares. The mileage rate must contain floating-point export noise, such as a long decimal representation infinitesimally above a normal currency rate. Present it as a system-exported rate, not as an unexplained typo.
source_construction.status_vocabulary: The source confirmations must use the status term Scheduled for finalized stops so the requested output vocabulary is reachable.

seeded_layout_defects.notes_overrides: For V03, V07, V11 and V14, put a clear correction or exception in the free-text Notes field that supersedes one corresponding main field. Across these records, cover effective availability, effective duration, meeting point and access instruction. The note must be understandable on its face but must not be accompanied by a general precedence rule.
seeded_layout_defects.headline_edge_case: Set one travelling child exactly at the harbour operator's inclusive adult-fare threshold. Applying the inclusive wording changes the projected harbour charge and total route cost compared with treating the child as below threshold.
seeded_layout_defects.floating_point_noise: Store or print the mileage reimbursement rate with harmless binary-style decimal noise. Gold calculations must normalize it to the business currency precision rather than test raw floating-point equality.

source_construction.excluded_defects: Do not add duplicates, missing fields, conflicting confirmations, hidden image-only facts, stale versions, formula errors, merged-data obstructions, unit mismatches, misspellings that change identity, or any other standard defect.

feasible_instance.construction_rule: First create a complete feasible gold route containing all fourteen viewings, S01, S02, B01, exactly four harbour crossing legs and one compliant break on each day. Then derive each viewing's source availability and the travel matrix around that route while preserving some sequencing flexibility.
feasible_instance.combined_constraint_trap: Arrange the windows and fixed appointments so that an intuitive plan that postpones a cross-harbour cluster until Tuesday afternoon remains feasible through Tuesday lunchtime but misses the hourly post-15:00 crossing and cannot complete the remaining effective windows. Do not describe this trap in the request or source.
feasible_instance.notice_rule: The record requiring twenty-four hours' notice must have a documented confirmation timestamp early enough for some, but not every, Monday slot. A compliant itinerary uses a slot at least twenty-four hours after that timestamp.
feasible_instance.language_rule: Ruslan must accompany Camila Zuniga at S01 and S02. No other person may be invented as a Portuguese interpreter.
feasible_instance.appointment_rule: All stops must begin within their effective windows, use effective durations after Notes corrections, include required check-in or loading buffers, and not overlap.
feasible_instance.crossing_rule: A harbour leg can begin only at a published departure after the required terminal check-in. Before 15:00 eligible departures are on the half-hour pattern; from 15:00 they are on the hourly pattern.
feasible_instance.travel_rule: For consecutive itinerary entries, the next start must be no earlier than prior end plus supplied travel time, terminal processing or crossing time as applicable.
feasible_instance.break_rule: Each day contains one uninterrupted break of at least the contractual duration, wholly inside the permitted interval and not concurrent with driving, check-in, crossing or an appointment.

gold_derivation.schedule: Use a reference script to parse or mirror all source constraints and verify the submitted sequence as a feasible schedule rather than requiring one literal ordering. Each source stop V01–V14, S01, S02 and B01 must appear exactly once.
gold_derivation.viewing_fields: For each V-code, compare the output's family, property, address, contact and execution details with the source. Determine effective time, duration, meeting point and access instruction by applying any explicit correction written in that record's Notes field.
gold_derivation.appointment_fields: For S01, S02 and B01, copy the confirmed identity, attendees, date, time, duration, location, contact and arrival instructions without reinterpretation.
gold_derivation.crossings: Validate each of C01–C04 against the published timetable, direction, terminal processing requirement, passenger assignment and crossing duration.
gold_derivation.distance: Planned kilometres equal the sum of supplied route distances for every consecutive movement in the submitted schedule, including terminal movements where the source table specifies them.
gold_derivation.mileage_cost: Normalize the noisy mileage rate to the displayed business currency precision, then multiply it by planned kilometres and round the resulting charge to currency precision.
gold_derivation.harbour_cost: Calculate vehicle and passenger fares for the four planned crossings from the supplied fare terms. Treat the child exactly at the inclusive age threshold as adult-fare eligible.
gold_derivation.parking_cost: Sum only parking charges triggered by the scheduled stops and their stated validation conditions.
gold_derivation.total_cost: Headline projected route cost equals normalized mileage reimbursement plus harbour charges plus parking charges. All component and headline amounts use currency precision.
gold_derivation.consistency: Every stop's date, start, end and family/passenger assignment must match between Client Check and Driver Run Sheet. Route & Cost Notes must reconcile to the actual submitted route.
gold_derivation.professional_quality: The driver sheet should be executable without returning to the source: chronological, legible, and sufficiently specific about where to go, whom to carry, whom to meet and what access action is required.
